dtc.priority: URGENT: Cloudflare blocks AI crawlers by default on every new domain — caioinsight.ai runs on Cloudflare Workers. Verify OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and Claude-SearchBot are not blocked under Security → Bots → Bot Fight Mode. Brands using Cloudflare are invisible to every AI engine until this is corrected. This is now Signal 0 in every client audit — check before anything else.

landscape.headline: Cloudflare silently blocking AI crawlers on 22% of the web — caioinsight.ai affected
landscape.body: Large-scale 2026 research confirms ChatGPT carousels are a structured retrieval layer on Google Shopping organic index. Top 40 Google Shopping rank = carousel eligibility. This means Signal 6 remediation is Google Shopping feed optimization + OAI-SearchBot access + JSON-LD Product schema. Not a black box. Actionable and concrete for every audit client.

landscape.headline: Shopify Catalog commoditizes basic GEO — diagnostic gap shifts to completeness and compliance
landscape.body: Shopify now auto-generates native /llms.txt and /agents.md routes for merchant stores. This partially closes Signal 2 automatically for Shopify merchants. Audit implication: check whether the auto-generated file is complete and accurate, not just present. Most auto-generated llms.txt files are incomplete stubs. Quality gap = billable remediation work.

landscape.headline: ChatGPT Instant Checkout: fewer than 30 Shopify merchants live — window is wide open
landscape.body: Fewer than 30 of Shopify's millions of merchants went live with ChatGPT Instant Checkout. The agentic commerce story is much earlier-stage than the market narrative suggests. The window to position as the diagnostic infrastructure layer is wide open.
